notes.title: V0.97 World Addon Editor Pt.1 | New Car Wheels & Futurism | Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello dear players![/h1]

[h3]I am back from my week long hiatus at real life Fort Dun, taking a break from electronics![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/5d3556d80359fb4121b0265ad1aed60aa1450199.png[/img]

[h3]I have been quite diligent these past two months![/h3]

[h2]The World Creator[/h2]
[b]
Before having left last week, I finished the first part of the World Editor, which I wanted to release to the main branch![/b]

[b]I let it cook a little longer while I was gone, to let a couple bugs trickle up, found by the reliable testers on my server, which had to be fixed still.[/b]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3428136874
[b]Here is an example island for you to download![/b]

[b]Import a height map (by editing the source image which has to be 513x513 pixels)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/90aad49a43b045f3f94751e9704efec35ddad8d9.gif[/img]
[b]And edit it to your liking [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/578be179eae2349f905188d978fc2fa4836a0dce.gif[/img]
[b]Add housing or custom meshes and tell the game if it should only appear during a specific time period[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/18813cfe05bb578e29451956c7ee682f7d2d05eb.gif[/img]
[b]You can travel to any level, by selecting it on the new world map. A level addon has a longitude/latitude coordinate, so you will be able to place your map anywhere on the world map.[/b]
[b]Double click on the map marker and fly towards the direction![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/fe2bef528f8f08458a40198d093f8154a0bf3484.gif[/img]
[b]If your level has a ship or airport connection, you will be able to connect to it that way.[/b]

[b]This way it was my hope for you to create custom worlds, to widen the scope of exploration in No Time.[/b]

[b]Does it still have bugs? Yes, as it is an early tool so I suggest creating backups of your mod after every edit at least for now. [/b]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3441923806
[b]You could create pretty interesting racing track islands for multiplayer with it.[/b]

[b]It is as of yet very unfinished, here is what is yet to come.[/b]
-Custom Npc Names (essentially a system which allows you to chose how to populate the island)
-A traffic system
-Item Editor (allows to create custom items: food, trinkets weapons)
-Quest Editor (Create your own time travel stories for your world addons)
-Custom Radio Stations, traders, and more essential systems

[b]They will likely be released in two further world addon updates in the future.[/b]

[h2]More futuristic Pine Lake![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/89b906325c423a9b99e2cd6da77bb4f879d82b2b.gif[/img]
[b]New futuristic cars can be seen on pine island.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/d5b973540a5187cb259c4f9b85f5b8b1283da73f.gif[/img]
[b]And new cosmetic wheels that come along with them.[/b]
[b]Even though I said cosmetic, most of the new wheels are available in the future and essentially allow an increased flight ability.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/ec05c44a6b25c4e55aed61cc527bc870a511299e.gif[/img]
[b]I call this one the metal knight. You can see the new real time reflections pretty well on this one[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/1c5c5855bb571e8f94444498e88fde1b6272174c.gif[/img]
[b]This one is the snow white rider setup.
I increased the albedo range on the car's main texture to allow for brighter looks.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/3affa56fab5746943769ea6a1aebbd5feffee63b.gif[/img]
[b]These sets of wheels will allow you better tracking across the field![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/4eb7fbc1352d57e41ec06a0ecf493fc3acc5c140.gif[/img]
[b]New technology merges with old technology in 2014 Pine Lake.[/b]

[b]I have a couple plans for the next content updates but I wanted to hear your opinion which should be focused on more first.[/b]

[list]
[*] Multiplayer (melee combat, some more time spent on performance improvements, etc)
[*] Custom Car modifications (enhance your time machine with new abilities, some perhaps allowing you to make the time travel sequence look different)
[*] Car Purchases (This one could be another update which takes longer to do, I was planning on the ability to buy cars and essentially switch them with your mach 3 in the garage, this would also basically make it so future car mods would have to be gotten from a car dealer)
[*] World Editor pt.2 (item editor, npc enemy update, store & shop system, traffic)
[/list]

[h2][b]Getting Closer to Beta[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=ElwaMYN-l7Y;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]I created a new No Time Trailer, check it out![/b]

[b]
Once No Time leaves alpha, beta will commence likely by new year. And with that an increased focus on improving the stability and performance of the game as well as crunching up which ever bugs remain, as well as quality of life improvements.

That does not mean that no content updates will occur after or even when No Time fully released.
However focus usually always gets narrowed on stability once all main features are finished.[/b]

[b]The first time since 2019, I have increased it by $2.99
given how much has changed and improved in the past six years since first release, whilst still not wanting to go a high price increase until the game really gets fully released.[/b]

[b][h3]As always thank for your support and good luck on your time travel adventures!
God bless.[/h3][/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.94p6 | IMPORTANT PERFORMANCE FIX
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello fellow players.
[/h2]
[h3]I had players reporting an increase in performance drop for some over time as they played on one save file, which turned out to be due to redundant copies of items caused by your past self taking an item back to its inventory.[/h3]

[h3]It should be fixed now and the redundant items will be removed out of your save file.
If you encountered this issue, save and load your save a couple times so it can cycle through your inventory and remove the fake copies.

This will work by the game checking if the item is in its box position, and later checking if it is not attached to any box in game.[/h3]

notes.title: 0.875 | THIRD PERSON UPDATE | BOUNTY HUNTING | HUGE CITIZEN REVAMPS!

[h2]Hello fellow players![/h2]

[h2]Last month there have been a few patches including some additions, which I chose to also cover in this announcement![/h2]
[Credit goes to Szogun and Time bandit for making screenshots for the Thumbnail]

[h3]TRAFFIC LIGHTS AND INTERSTATE ROADS[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/4aa97fd26e54306b21d7e57d2967a45ff762f940.gif[/img]
[h3]Pine Island finally has some traffic rules in place! Cars still sometimes tend to crash, but they drive more carefully now ;)[/h3]

[h3]I thought of making high way around pine island less linear and more interesting, I might expand on that in the next update after this one.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/237616887406925daa577e464836a4b434fd6e5e.png[/img]
[h3]Here you can see a road leading between pine lake and fisher bay.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/99bc772309fffbaf4de71aeb88504302ad317e38.gif[/img]
[h3]Fisher Bay itself has some road remodeling![/h3]
[h3]As you can see the ocean finally blends in well with the atmospheric fog.[/h3]

[h3]THIRD PERSON MODE[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/07d99f631c4175aea82311f1d6b4fc7ca816fc0f.gif[/img]
[h3]Simply press V when ever you feel like it, to see how beautiful you look from a thirds eye perspective![/h3]

[h3]CITIZEN & PROCEDURAL FAMILY TREES[/h3]

[h3]The game now has a new feature in place which I have planned for long.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/104c891c93daa22df92593e53f6ca8d405e3ed9d.png[/img]
[h3]Every Citizen Npc now has a unique look, no more duplicates! 
I've built a new system from the ground up where faces, skin color, gender, and clothing all mix together to create a unique look.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/be564afe1fc6cdf3169496ab68ff434aa8e3fde4.png[/img]
[h3]Npcs also wear weather appropriate clothing! (Picture made by Davesoft) [/h3]

[h3]Secondly all NPC's from the 16th century (Cape Dun gets founded) to 2030 (and soon also 70)
are part of a procedural family tree system. [/h3]

It works as follows:
[h3]
1#
[b]A family migrates to one of three locations[/b]
-Ard Vuran (A desert country)
-Archos (The trading guild island)
-Lechwia (The temperate climate)[/h3]
[url=https://no-time.fandom.com/wiki/Map:Lechwia]Click here for a map of a portion of Antillia[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/cc47873b296e71dc2259ae6bba6cb39724e70a0f.gif[/img]
[h3]2#[b]They then marry, have children and if other cities are available, move to other cities.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/695254be4bf414647f54aab5cbbd541149c21112.png[/img]
[h3]3#[b]And eventually they die, this is when you will be able to look at a local graveyard and see their entries there...[/b][/h3]

[h3]Depending on random chance, or economical situation (or if the family is called Crimson)
there is a chance for an npc to turn EVIL. They will become ruffians and bandits and over time they will do crime, rob, kill and even capture innocent citizen, to drag them into their hideouts. Saving citizens may have unforeseen consequences as to how the family trees will look in the future. New NPC's might get born or entire families will look completely different![/h3]
[h3]
(Note that as new updates come, some families might change during your playthrough as the procedural structure could get altered by adding new features or quests in that regard)

BOUNTY HUNTING & BULLETIN BOARDS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/f4e2505617deb37770cb76a7dc825e9589f97929.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/954dc15da97c41c5c08fedc1cb71bab0f93c23a5.gif[/img]
[h3]To prevent them from doing harm you can take up hints from the bulletin boards, where they might be hiding.[/h3]
[h3]Every city has its own board with local affairs.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/097ca022a2adc7434e56e018e6938dd6c3c2e67e.gif[/img]
[h3]
Follow the wanted lead, free the prisoners and bind the ruffian, drag him to either Westwood or Cape Duns barracks master, and collect your reward![/h3]
[h3]
This is one of the first radiant tasks which I wanted to implement for long. (Perhaps job requests or animal/ monster hunting will be added in the future)[/h3]

[h3]RENZO & JOACHIM
A digital comic is being made by Rensow, telling the story of the Gold Time Line (The original timeline which initiated the whole adventure of No Time)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/b3033e65debe05fa0d88cca847b7a4be76d9302a.png[/img]
[h3]He has made his own stories before, so we thought that it be cool if I implemented characters out of his personal stories into No time.[/h3]

[h3]There is a little easter egg in No Time, where you can spot them. Go to Edds basement and find the hint as to their location and time period.
Next update will likely be focused on the post 2030 future up to 2070/80, so this is something to definitely look forward to :)[/h3]

[h2][b]If you like No Time and are stoked about this update, and want to aid in its growth, share the game with your friends or write a comment about it on your Social Media! 

If you have favorite Streamer or Youtuber, write a comment about No Time. For every 10 people who see your comment, one might like it and might even check the game out! ːsteamhappyː[/b][/h2]

Thanks again to everyone who has been along the ride so far.

[h3]At times a trader approaches your safe house. He is the main source of safe house customisation![/h3]

Hope you enjoy, God bless!

notes.title: Update v0.3416 | 1 year anniversary | Work on ACT III has started |
notes.notes:
Hey guys.
I wanted to let you know that the game is now one year old since October 26th :D
Lemme rehash how all came together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/1434ed72b85ffda07d485ad141d01c97b59ae0f2.png[/img]

One night I had the idea of making a time travel game. The idea was that you would be actually able to travel to any date in time :D

So I spent the night with a donut and some coffee to work out the basic structure of driving a car / time system / a tracker, which would record the cars actions and so on.

From there I started on a basic story. I was thinking of you selling things to an antiquities shop. The original inventor (who was your co worker) was kidnapped in this version of the story and was forced to work on inventions for the time agents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/1e62c9d8246f18823b2e7036723d5cda409d5f41.jpg[/img]
[i]This is the original plan for the map. I am sure some of it may actually look better than it does right now. Some might have looked worse. What I am saying is if you liked some of the original plans let me know and I can see if I can implement it :)[/i]

This antiquities shop later became E.R. Athors lab. And the inventor himself was now the shop owner, instead of being kidnapped. Originally his shop would have been a shack next to the Burger Lord (As a nod to BTTF with docs shack next to the burger king)

I dropped that idea at some point but you can still see the shack. It is just somewhere different. It is now the blacksmith's shop.

Incidentally the Weathermachine quest (and the character E.R. Athor) is a story I pulled entirely from a semi abandoned RPG I never released. So there is this whole back story. The game is called Dark Sea. It may get a real release at some point, thought it may be an entirely different game by then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/90edc495e9f0c34a7ee407ff61e006b7511a985a.png[/img]

Of course this is not the end yet but see how far we have come in one year. Let us see how far we can get in another one :D

I recently started work on ACT III.
This last act may take a bit longer, because not only am I going to revamp features or add new ones to the list.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710162/af62656a48552e51e551ff48a34a90b98d503bd5.png[/img]

I will revamp ACT I with an intro section showing how it all came to be (The escape from the facility and so on).
Act II may also get some changes to make a better pacing though I have no really clear goals on that.

To bridge this time gap I will continue with posting smaller side stories and things for you to do :)

Thank you all for bearing with me on this project and let us see where it all will go.

notes.title: Status Update & Roadmap

[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Some days passed since the announced update but finally I made it... Sorry for the ultra long delay.
Something in the game was causing the program to freeze and crash. I was using any time I could spare to fix the current issue we where having.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Meanwhile I wanted to let you know what the plans are for the near future and beyond!

As you may know, we have been working on Act II for the past month or so now.
Progress on the script is going well! Most of everything is already set in stone. However, because of the current crashes I was restricted to what I could work on. The crash bug took full priority.

Some information for ACT II:

The second act will most likely have the same length of Act I.
With the release or shortly after I will include 3 side quests.
One will be a quest about the 'probably known' Accordion Man (who is being talked about in the game)

The other two side quests will take place around the year 2010 and onwards.

And for even more in the future...

- multiple side quests and attractions
- reworking the saving system
- POSSIBLY reworking the time tracking (making it dynamic and not a static tracking of the player)
-I will start work on act III and will add a prologue which will explain the story before you start the game in current versions.

(So no worries if you don't like something while playing these acts you may have a chance seeing a complete overhaul)

Hope this shows you that work on this project is going well! At our current rate we might be finishing the game around Winter.

I have high hopes that we can make this project a truly outstanding experience during this development cycle.
